title: Learning to Learn
purpose: A proposed course in the Corniversity catalogue (Optional advanced elective). Meta-learning, adaptation, transfer and evaluation across tasks, with explicit attention to how an evaluation distinguishes meaningful adaptation from memorised task overlap or leakage.
description: Proposed course: Learning to Learn. Central question: How can a system adapt to new tasks, and how do we know the adaptation is real? Source verification and syllabus design have not been completed, so no teaching material exists yet. You may register interest or ask the director about it; nothing is prepared on request.
